parts.text:
**"Still in Love with You"** is a track by the iconic country music duo **Brooks & Dunn**. 

### Key Facts:
* **Album:** It was released on their debut studio album, ***Brand New Man***, which came out on August 13, 1991.
* **Songwriters:** The song was written by Kix Brooks, Ronnie Dunn, and Don Cook. 
* **Producers:** Don Cook and Scott Hendricks.
* **Background Vocals:** Dennis Wilson.

---

### Lyrics:

> **[Verse 1]**
> My taxicab's waiting
> Wish I could hold you one last time
> After all we had together
> There's gotta be a better way
> Of telling you goodbye
> 
> **[Chorus]**
> If I had a horse
> I'd ride off in the sunset
> If I had wings, I'd fly off
> In the sky so blue
> If I had the time, I'd spend my
> Whole life dreaming
> But I'd wake up, still in love with you
> 
> **[Verse 2]**
> Be in Baton Rouge by morning
> Hope you're missing me by then
> I'd like to be the kind of memory
> That makes you want to take me back
> In your arms again
> 
> **[Chorus]**
> If I had a horse
> I'd ride off in the sunset
> If I had wings, I'd fly off
> In the sky so blue
> If I had the time, I'd spend my
> Whole life dreaming
> But I'd wake up, still in love with you
> 
> **[Bridge]**
> Some night when you get lonely
> Will you still remember me
> 
> **[Chorus]**
> If I had a horse
> I'd ride off in the sunset
> If I had wings, I'd fly off
> In the sky so blue
> If I had the time, I'd spend my
> Whole life dreaming
> But I'd wake up, still in love with you
> 
> **[Outro]**
> Yeah, I'd wake up, still in love with you
